History Report & Utility VIs

Owning Palette: Variabe History VIs

No description.

 

Palette Object Description
VHist - Fit DBL history to new timestamps.vi Looks over DBL history and determines history values at the new time stamps specified. New time stamps can be specified either in new time stamps array or time conditions cluster defining initial and final timestamps, and time step. Optionally, VI can interpolate absent values or replace them with NaN.
VHist - Fit multi DBL history to new timestamps.vi Looks over several DBL histories and determines values of every history at the new common time stamps. New time stamps can be specified either in new time stamps array or time conditions cluster defining initial and final time, and time step. Optionally, VI can interpolate absent values or replace them with NaN.
VHist - Fit multi STR history to new timestamps.vi Looks over several String histories and determines values of every history at the new common time stamps. New time stamps can be specified either in new time stamps array or time conditions cluster defining initial and final time, and time step. By default, VI replaces absent values with an empty string and merges values located between adjacent new time stamps. Either of these features can be suppressed.
VHist - Fit STR history to new timestamps.vi Looks over String history and determines history values at the new time stamps specified. New time stamps can be specified either in new time stamps array or time conditions cluster defining initial and final timestamps, and time step. By default, VI replaces absent values with an empty string and merges values located between adjacent new time stamps. Either of these features can be suppressed.
VHist - Interpolate DBL History.vi Inserts the specified timestamp and either interpolated or extrapolated value at this timestamp into an appropriate position in DBL history. Interpolation method can be linear (by default), spline, polynominal or rational.
VHist - Interpolate multi DBL History.vi Inserts the specified timestamp and either interpolated or extrapolated values at this timestamp into an appropriate position in multiple DBL history. Interpolation method can be linear (by default), spline, polynominal or rational.
VHist - Multiple DBL history to spreadsheet string.vi Converts multiple DBL history to spreadsheet string.
VHist - Multiple DBL history to Table.vi Converts multiple DBL history to 2D array of strings that can be displayed in a table. The VI returns time stamps in a separate 1D array of string that can be passed to a table header (e.g. row headers).
VHist - Time Range from history array.vi Looks over several DBL histories and returns the oldest and the newest time stamps found.
